rulings.why: Verified: record has only focusPoolBonus:1, no choice and no focusSpells; the 35 advanced-domain spell ids in the fix all exist in core.json and feat effectChoices ARE resolved (build.ts:2458) with grantsFocusViaEffectChoice suppressing the double pool point.

Real bug confirmed at build.ts:1481 - choice.kind=="domains" resolves through DOMAIN_SPELLS which holds only INITIAL spells. NOTE FOR APPLY: the existing choice{flag:advancedDomain,kind:domains} must be REMOVED at the same time, or the feat grants BOTH the initial and the advanced spell.
Verified: focusPoolBonus:1 only, no choice, no focusSpells, not in any registry or effect-backfill. effectChoices/focusSpells is the shipped lane (holy-bloom, order-spell).
Verified: CASTER_ARCHETYPES (src/rules/casterArchetypes.ts) has no red-mantis entry and SpellSlotBonus has no rank-ladder lane, so the 2nd/3rd/4th-rank slots never appear. needsEngineWork is honest.
Verified: 13 of the 14 wizard subclass options carry advancedFocusSpell, but ADV_SPELL (build.ts:1462) maps only advanced/greater-bloodline and advanced/greater-revelation. Real one-line engine gap.

Verified: no fields, no registry, no backfill; all four spell ids (animal-feature, enlarge-companion, hunters-luck, soothing-mist) exist in core.json with ranger+focus traits. NOTE: maxTakable>1 but an effectChoices pick is keyed once per record, so repeat takings share one pick.

Not an umbrella (no kin) and not a duplicate, so it is a visible ownable artifact; the ancestry-feat benefit is player-facing and featPickGrants.ts is feat-keyed, so an item-driven open feat pick genuinely has no lane.

Unobtainable aon- duplicate scrape: canonical feat empty-body exists with the same name (and already carries focusSpells:["embrace-nothingness"]), so findDuplicateIds in src/data/index.ts hides aon-empty-body from every picker.

Verified: fullCasterSlots sets slots[10]=1 at level 19+ (spellcasting.ts:33) and SpellSlotBonus exposes only perRank/exceptHighest/entryId (types.ts:358), so a second rank-10 slot cannot be expressed. Same engine lane as the ring-of-wizardry byRank gap.
Verified: cathartic-mage is absent from CASTER_ARCHETYPES, so the basic/expert/master ladder unlocks nothing.

Unobtainable: its only trait is "pervasive-magic" and its category is "class", so featSlots.eligibleFor (src/rules/featSlots.ts:59-66) never offers it in a class slot (no class trait, not archetype) nor in any other slot category. No player can take it.
Same verified gap as archwizards-might: slots[10] is hardcoded to 1 and SpellSlotBonus cannot target a single rank.

Verified: only uses{current:1,max:1}; "two additional slots at half your highest rank" is expressible by neither spellSlotBonus nor the consumable-modes lane. Player-facing (the buyer is the divine caster).
captivator-dedication IS in CASTER_ARCHETYPES, but nothing raises the usesPerDay of already-granted innate spells - there is no such field. Gap is real.

Verified against casterArchetypes.ts:94-110: halcyon-speaker-dedication has a fixed cantrip count and a customUnlocks list that does not include this feat, so the extra cantrip and 1st-rank spell never arrive.
Verified: record carries frequency{1,day} + passiveEffects{diplomacy:1} only. Item innateSpells is the shipped lane and heroism is rank 3 divine/occult, so the value is correct.
Verified: SpellSlotBonus has no fixed-rank-set and no content restriction, and the eligible spells depend on the conscious-mind subclass.

Correct and well-shaped: the batch-2 precedent wayfinder-resonance-infiltrator carries BOTH limitedUses{1,day} and innateSpells, so adding innateSpells beside the existing limitedUses is the shipped pattern. truesight exists (rank 6, all four traditions).
Verified: battle-harbinger is absent from CASTER_ARCHETYPES and no field expresses rank-laddered slots restricted to a named spell list.

All 11 curse-of-* features are orphaned; a situationalBonuses entry keyed to this id would never display.

Verified: championDevotionSpell (build.ts:860) returns undefined unless the CLASS carries the devotion-spells feature, so a Champion Dedication archetype gets the focusPoolBonus and no spell. All three spell ids exist.
limitedUses{max:2,per:"day"} is the legal, shipped feat-resource lane (featUses.ts) and the record carries no fields at all.

Same verified DOMAIN_SPELLS defect as advanced-domain (build.ts:1481) - the oracle is handed the INITIAL spell. needsEngineWork (an ADVANCED_DOMAIN_SPELLS map) is an honest alternative to a per-record option list.

Verified: backfill supplies only senses[darkvision]; EffectGrant.speeds is legal on a feat effectChoice. NOTE: verify the per-element Elemental Form speeds before applying, and the element is already known from the kinetic gate so the picker is a duplicate ask.
Verified: counters/frequency only. Item innateSpells is legal and usesPer:"hour" is a real InnateSpellGrant field (types.ts:532, display-only).
